## Here are 2026’s best Thanksgiving dinners, from classic roast turkey to Peking duck


Feast mode: activate![Thanksgiving](https://www.goldbelly.com/holidays/thanksgiving) 2026 is Thursday, November 26, and the easiest way to host is to let a legendary restaurant do the cooking. The best Thanksgiving dinners to order online this year come from icons like Commander’s Palace in New Orleans, Feges BBQ in Houston, and Zahav in Philadelphia. Every dinner below ships nationwide on Goldbelly, and most arrive fully cooked and ready to reheat.


This year’s list covers classic roast turkey dinners, smoked and fried turkey, global twists on turkey day, and non-traditional mains like ham, lamb, Peking duck, and fried chicken.

## **** **What Should You Serve for Thanksgiving Dinner?**


A classic Thanksgiving dinner is roast turkey with stuffing, gravy, cranberry sauce, mashed potatoes, sweet potatoes, and pie. Smoked turkey, fried turkey, and ham are the most popular alternatives, and global flavors like Lebanese, Israeli, and Chinese are showing up on more tables every year. For a fully non-turkey menu, browse[non-traditional Thanksgiving food](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/non-traditional-thanksgiving-food) .


## **** **Classic Roast Turkey Dinners**


The best classic Thanksgiving dinners pair a roast turkey with the traditional sides, made by restaurants that have perfected them.


### **** **** **** **** **Commander’s Palace’s Holiday Dinner**


New Orleans’ legendary Commander’s Palace brings Haute Creole style to Thanksgiving with herb butter-injected turkey and a whole pecan pie for dessert.


- **Serves:** 4
- **Includes:** sliced all white meat turkey, molasses & sea salt whipped sweet potatoes, smoked tasso & andouille stuffing, and a 9.5″ pecan pie, with optional Cognac turkey gravy
- **Arrives:** cooked, ready to reheat


**[Holiday Dinner >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/commanders-palace/commanders-palace-holiday-dinner-for-4)**


### **** **** **Lido Kosher Deli’s Kosher Thanksgiving Dinner**


Lido Kosher Deli’s recipes go back more than 90 years to a kosher meat factory in the Bronx, and its Long Beach, New York, deli ships a certified kosher, dairy-free, and nut-free Thanksgiving dinner nationwide.


- **Serves:** 4-6, or 6-8 with the larger kit
- **Includes (4-6 kit):** fresh turkey, stuffing, cranberry compote, gravy, and sweet potato pudding


**[Kosher Thanksgiving Dinner >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/lido-kosher-deli/kosher-thanksgiving-dinner-for-4-6)**


## **** **Smoked & Fried Turkey Dinners**


Smoked and fried turkey are the two most popular ways to upgrade the Thanksgiving bird, and both come from BBQ and Cajun specialists.


### **Feges BBQ’s “Whole Shebang” Thanksgiving Dinner**


Houston’s Feges BBQ smokes a whole turkey low and slow over post oak, then surrounds it with Southern sides that have a global twist.


- **Serves:** 6-8
- **Includes:** whole smoked turkey (8-10 lbs.), gravy, pimento mac & cheese, loaded potato mash, Moroccan spiced carrots, Korean braised greens, hogfat cornbread batter to bake at home, and cinnamon-honey butter
- **Arrives:** cooked, ready to reheat


[“The Whole Shebang” Thanksgiving Dinner >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/feges-bbq/the-whole-shebang-thanksgiving-dinner-for-6-8)


### **** **** **** **The Cajun Turkey Company’s Complete Fried Turkey Dinner**


Billy Howell started frying Cajun turkeys in his Dallas garage, and The Cajun Turkey Company now ships the whole feast nationwide, with your choice of spicy or lightly seasoned turkey.


- **Serves:** 12-15
- **Includes:** a 10-12 lb. Cajun fried turkey, mashed potatoes, green bean casserole, seafood bites, crawfish étouffée, sweet potato soufflé, turkey & giblet gravy, and a bottle of Geaux Juice
- **Arrives:** fully cooked, ready to reheat


**[Cajun Fried Turkey Dinner >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/the-cajun-turkey-company/235301-cajun-fried-turkey-dinner)**


**Read More:[Why the Best Thanksgiving Turkey is Smoked](https://blog.goldbelly.com/thanksgiving-smoked-turkey/)**


## **** **Turkey With a Twist**


These dinners keep turkey at the center but cook it in a style you won’t find at most Thanksgiving tables.


### **Ilili’s Lebanese-Inspired Thanksgiving Feast**


ilili, the upscale Lebanese restaurant in New York’s Flatiron neighborhood, brines its turkey for 24 hours and slow-roasts it for four.


- **Serves:** 4
- **Includes:** turkey breast and dark meat, turkey stock, stuffing grand-mère, gravy, cranberry sauce, mashed potatoes, and a pumpkin candy bar
- **Arrives:** cooked, ready to reheat


**[Thanksgiving Feast >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/ilili/thanksgiving-feast-for-4)**


### **** **** **** **** **** **Joe’s KC BBQ’s Whole Smoked Turkey Breast Full Dinner**


Kansas City’s Joe’s KC BBQ pairs a smoked turkey breast with its Louisiana-inspired dirty rice and signature BBQ beans for a Kansas City-style Thanksgiving.


- **Serves:** 6-8
- **Includes:** a whole smoked turkey breast (about 3 lbs.), two pounds of dirty rice, a quart of BBQ beans, and a bottle of Joe’s Original Bar-B-Que Sauce
- **Arrives:** cooked, ready to reheat


[Whole Smoked Turkey Breast Dinner >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/joes-kansas-city-bar-b-que/whole-smoked-turkey-breast-dinner)


## **** **** **Non-Traditional Thanksgiving Dinner Ideas**


Ham and lamb are the most popular non-turkey Thanksgiving centerpieces, and these two come from James Beard-caliber kitchens.


### **Cochon Butcher’s Holiday Ham Dinner**


New Orleans’ Cochon Butcher glazes its ham with Louisiana Steen’s cane syrup and whole grain mustard. Once you try it, you may never go back to turkey.


- **Serves:** 6-8
- **Includes:** a 3.8-5 lb. ham, Steen’s mustard glaze, mac ‘n cheese, bacon-braised greens, and 12 dinner rolls


**[Holiday Ham Dinner >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/cochon-butcher/holiday-ham-dinner-for-6-8)**


**Read More:[Type of Ham: Explained](https://blog.goldbelly.com/types-of-ham/)**


### **** **Zahav’s Lamb Shoulder Meal Kit**


The signature dish at chef Michael Solomonov’s Zahav, named James Beard’s Outstanding Restaurant in 2019, is a lamb shoulder that’s brined, smoked, confited, and finished in a pomegranate glaze.


- **Serves:** 6-8
- **Includes:** the lamb shoulder, hummus, pita, six seasonal salatim, spiced jasmine rice, and olive oil basboosa for dessert
- **Arrives:** ready to finish in your oven in under an hour


**[Lamb Shoulder Meal Kit >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/zahav/zahav-lamb-shoulder-meal-kit)**


## **** **** **Crowd-Pleasing Turkey Alternatives**


Peking duck and fried chicken are two of the most crowd-pleasing swaps for turkey, especially for families with picky eaters.


### **Philippe Chow’s Signature Beijing-Style Dinner Kit**


Philippe Chow, one of New York’s most elegant Beijing-style restaurants since 2004, ships its signature Peking duck whole, ready to heat and slice at home.


- **Serves:** 4-6
- **Includes:** a whole Peking duck (about 5 lbs.), 12 pancakes, plum sauce, cucumbers, 12 dumplings of your choice, and 6 chicken satay skewers with satay sauce


**[Beijing-Style Dinner Kit >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/philippe-chow/signature-beijing-style-dinner-kit-for-4-6)**


### **Blue Ribbon’s Complete Fried Chicken Dinner**


NYC’s Blue Ribbon makes the fried chicken Food & Wine named “Best in the Country” in 2011, and this dinner scales it up for the whole table.


- **Serves:** 8-10
- **Includes:** 16 pieces of fried chicken, 2 quarts each of mashed potatoes and collard greens, chicken gravy, wildflower honey, fried chicken seasoning, and habanero hot sauce


**[Complete Fried Chicken Dinner >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/blue-ribbon/the-family-coop-complete-fried-chicken-dinner-for-8)**

## **Thanksgiving Dinner FAQs**


**When should I order Thanksgiving dinner online?**


Thanksgiving is Thursday, November 26, 2026. Order 1–2 weeks before for the best selection, since popular Thanksgiving dinners can sell out as the holiday gets closer. Select your delivery date at checkout, and your order will ship to arrive fresh on or before Thanksgiving, depending on the maker’s production schedule.


**Do Thanksgiving dinners from Goldbelly arrive cooked?**


Most do. Turkey dinners from Commander’s Palace, Feges BBQ, The Cajun Turkey Company, ilili, and Joe’s KC BBQ all arrive cooked and only need reheating. Each product page has heating instructions.


**How many people does a Thanksgiving dinner kit feed?**


Thanksgiving dinners on Goldbelly serve anywhere from 4 people to more than 24. The dinners on this list range from 4 to 15. For bigger gatherings, browse[Thanksgiving feast kits](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/thanksgiving-feast-kits) .


**What are some non-traditional Thanksgiving dinner ideas?**


Glazed ham, smoked lamb shoulder, Peking duck, and fried chicken are the most popular turkey alternatives. Shop more[non-traditional Thanksgiving food](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/non-traditional-thanksgiving-food) from America’s top restaurants.
